title: Infinite Scrolling Landscape
description: An infinite-feeling cityscape rendered from a finite pool of N pre-allocated SceneObjects (each carrying one mesh per shared primitive: box, slab, cylinder, dome). An external instruction-source module emits, per frame, an array of {slotId, geomType, transform, color, opacity} tuples — index.js writes them straight onto the matching slot's active SceneMesh. As the user drags the canvas, slots that scroll past one edge wrap to the opposite side and are re-randomised from a deterministic hash of (slotId, wrapCountX, wrapCountY), giving the illusion of an endless skyline while reusing the same handful of geometries.
